resources.string: Source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (about 90 m grid). This is an estimated surface height; it may include buildings or trees and cannot determine a floor.
Selecting a target or entering its coordinates automatically looks up its height. A cached estimate is used first; otherwise the target coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo.
